newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTAN MONEY RATES SEE-SAW ON OMO, SEEN SOFT.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN MONEY RATES SEE-SAW ON OMO, SEEN SOFT.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates fluctuated widely on Wednesday after the central bank conducted its regular open market operation (OMO), dealers said.
Dealers said the State (central) Bank of Pakistan mopped up about 1.5 billion rupees against an inflow of OMO maturity of 3.8 billion rupees at a cut-off yield of 14.90 percent.

"As a result, the overnights traded in a wide range of 8.0 to 13 percent," said a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank. The market ended in surplus and rates were expected to stay soft on Friday, he added.
